messages:
maya: heads-up — we're getting noisy pages from eviction/preempt spikes in us-west during autoscaler churn, pages all night even though user-facing latency is fine.

sam: ugh. are these preemptions tied to spot reclaim windows or legitimate OOMs?

maya: looks like spot preempts + a few flaky drivers. Prometheus shows short bursts: lots of pod terminations but most are <=2min and recover.

jordan: can you paste the prometheus queries? want to see cardinality.

maya: sure — quick snippet:
```promql
sum by(node) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_terminated_reason{reason=~"OOMKilled|Preempted"}[5m]))
```

maya: bursts hit ~30 nodes for 2–3m, then drop. paging threshold is currently any 5 nodes in 3m which is too sensitive for spot churn.

sam: propose: only page when sustained across two windows AND cross-zone. i.e. require >5 nodes *and* total evictions in 10m > 20, or if affected nodes span >=2 AZs. otherwise create a ticket and attach logs.

jordan: +1. also group alerts by cluster + root-cause label (preempt|oom|driver) so one page covers the whole event.

maya: rough rule draft:
```yaml
alert: EvictionBurstHighCardinality
expr: |
  cardinality(sum by(node) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_terminated_reason[5m]))) > 8
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: ticket
annotations:
  summary: "Eviction bursts detected (low severity)"
```
and a paging variant:
```yaml
alert: EvictionWidespreadPaging
expr: |
  (sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_terminated_reason{reason=~"Preempted|OOMKilled"}[10m])) > 20)
  and (count_values("az", kube_node_labels_az) > 1)
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: pager
annotations:
  runbook: "/runbooks/eviction-handling.md"
```

sam: that looks good. can we add a noisy-suppression window tied to autoscaler events? e.g. if `kube_cluster_autoscaler_events > 0` in last 15m then downgrade to ticket.

jordan: yep — we should also correlate with scheduled maintenance tags from cloud provider. add a label `maintenance: true` to mute paging.

maya: I'll prototype rules in staging and run them against last 30 days of metrics to compute false positives.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-145 — investigation started (assigned: maya) :gear:

sam: thanks. once we have the sim results, let's schedule a 20m sync to finalize thresholds. I can bring historical pager counts + cost impact.

jordan: one more thought — for tickets, include a small SLO check: if P99 latency increases > 20% alongside evictions then escalate to pager immediately. otherwise ticket.

maya: noted. adding `p99_latency_ratio` check to the paging expr. will post PR with test data. :thumbsup:
